evidence: Specific to this product: the pick-up day calendar on /tool.html marks library sessions ('Open' on Wed/Sat; green dot at 375), the 'Available from Sat 10 Oct' availability chip on every find card (one-of-each stock), deposit shown in each card meta line, the basket's list of real opening sessions, and the done page's 'Deposit to bring' / 'What happens next' panel. Those make the library's model of sessions, deposits and one copy of each tool visible.

Generic: the visual layer would pass the swap test. Find page = H1, intro paragraph, full-width search + filter icon, 2-column grid of white bordered cards each with an identical pale-green wrench tile (the header logo glyph repeated 10 times), underlined title, grey meta and a tinted chip. Swap the words and it is any catalogue or booking service.

Category-guess / similar-prompt: a 'community tool library reservation, accessible, plain' brief would land about here: a single forest-green accent on an off-white page, humanist sans, GOV.UK-style error summary and radio cards, a wrench icon as the only imagery.

unfinished: All ten find cards carry the same placeholder wrench tile where a picture of the tool would go; it reads as an image slot never filled (items-ladder-3m/default/1280-light).

Browser-default date input ('yyyy/mm/dd' with native calendar glyph) and a native select with a different chevron from the Loan length select in the filter panel (items-ladder-3m/filters-open/1280-light).

Basket session tiles at 1280 wrap 'Saturday 24 / October, 10:00 to / 13:00' into three ragged lines with the time stranded, while one session (28 Oct) sits alone on a full-width row above five narrow tiles (basket/default/1280-light).
'Opening times' on the find page is only a heading and a paragraph; the footer is one line of grey text.
Short pages (basket, done at 1280) end with the footer floating mid-viewport and an empty grey band below it.
Hierarchy is carried only by bold size steps of the same sans; there is no typographic moment, imagery or colour block anywhere in the flow.
At 375 the card titles are truncated with ellipses ('Cordless drill 18 V, co...') and the three nav links each wrap to two lines.
Tool details list uses two different label column widths (Category/Deposit/Available vs Chuck/Batteries/Weight/Case), so values do not line up.
evidence: First viewport of / at 1280: a large bold 'Find a tool', a grey paragraph, an empty search box and a grid of identical cards. It is tidy and legible, but there is nothing to look at except text and one repeated icon. A volunteer library would find it usable and respectable, but not distinctive or warm.

The colour and type are consistent and calm in both themes, the green primary buttons are confident, and the error summary is well formed. That is clean, not appealing: it is finished as a form, not as a place.
After scrolling: more identical cards, then a text-only Opening times section and a single-line footer, with no change in rhythm.
